snippet.title: Casebook 1899 - Teaser
snippet.description:
Casebook 1899 is a dialog-driven point-and-click-adventure which will make you feel like a real detective of the German Kaiserreich. A Kickstarter-campaign to fund the development will launch in summer 2022 alongside a the first case you can play for free.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841190
Follow the development: https://homo-narrans-studio.de/
